units.analysis_unit_id: Evaluated document/workflow version, not automatically the registered publication
units.current_unit_input: 71 rows: 68 active units plus 3 non-primary version/context objects
units.main: 67 retained inventory-version units plus one SHA-bound Liu GHGT evaluated document
units.strict: 23 members within the 68; formal identity and evaluated-claim bridge, not venue alone
units.field_relation: 32 source-project/site/event relations; not 32 unique sites, experiments, ML studies or positives
units.event: event_unit_type/id blanks remain blanks; do not infer independent events from project names
units.historical: 57 original manual-comparison records, 627 paper-field items, not expanded human recoding
units.score: Ordinal 0-4 with separate missing state; no weighted total
units.pair: Joint-count denominator is pair_effective_N; missing margins separately retained
units.indicator: Available is positive plus classifiable non-positive, not the full N
units.physical_union: Seven prespecified diagnostic components; not exhaustive physics and not equivalent to score >=3
